About.title: About Us
About.desc: Welcome to Khushaal Honey & Dairy Producers Association, an initiative under the GBDSGNS Foundation, where we are committed to enhancing the livelihoods of rural farmers and fostering sustainable agricultural practices. Our journey began with a simple vision: to support local honey and dairy producers, empowering them through education, better practices, and access to broader markets.

WhyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Us?
WhyChooseUs.subtitle: Direct access to global livestock biotechnology and cooperative member benefits.
WhyChooseUs.item1Desc: Registered FPO under NABARD and SFAC guidelines. Bulk discounts, subsidies, and patronage profits stay with member farmers.
WhyChooseUs.item2Desc: Directly imported bovine semen straws from the Netherlands & USA with verified high TPI, milk yield, and fertility indexes.
WhyChooseUs.item3Desc: Liquid nitrogen cold-chain transit maintained from international laboratories directly to your farm gate.
WhyChooseUs.item4Desc: Exclusive distributor of Kanters Exolium chelated hoof care for effective Mortellaro prevention with zero milk discard.
